brief: Organizing rule: equal-width columns, two matched-height horizontal scientific lanes, common left/right image bounds, and one short centered conditioning strip. The whole silhouette is rectangular and balanced; denoising spans two cells and the single shared decoder spans the lane height. Keep the blue architectural palette and red cross-attention focus. Every main route is a straight axis-aligned source-border to target-border arrow. Training-only noising uses the empty left inter-lane corridor; the condition branch uses the short central corridor. Draw bounding boxes as invisible layout bounds except where a scientific model/group needs a frame. No extra stages, empty cards, ornament or invented scientific symmetry. Place all text clear of the actual continuous shafts.

ideas.concept: Separate perceptual compression and latent generation in equal-height aligned lanes.
ideas.visual_intent: Preserve image-valued thumbnails and two-dimensional spatial latent states while making their two roles immediately comparable.
ideas.construction_plan: Match input/reconstruction/generated thumbnail sizes; use aligned native plane grids for latents. The fixed forward-noising training branch uses exact reserved points and a short nearby dark caption. Caption never erases a shaft. Decoder appears once as a shared vertical whole-model block with two independent port pairs, not repeated stand-ins.

ideas.concept: Give the innovative denoising and conditional attention mechanism an integer two-column span.
ideas.visual_intent: Show what condition controls and retain meaningful small scientific visuals without losing the regular silhouette.
ideas.construction_plan: Draw one flat U-shaped multiscale feature icon with one red cross-attention insert. Q originates at a spatial feature, K,V enter from the condition encoder at the declared top port. A small internal sequence of spatial grids conveys iteration rather than decorative particle dots. Use readable short labels, true subscript t and zero, identical arrowheads and consistent stroke. Re-trace every shaft after text placement.
